cinder_log_dir.description: Directory where Cinder API logs will be stored.

cinder_log_file.description: Name of the main log file for Cinder API.

api_bind_host.description: IP address or hostname on which the Cinder API listens.

api_bind_port.description: Port number the Cinder API listens on.

use_database.description: Set to true if the API node needs database access (e.g., for read replicas or deployments where the API stores state). Usually false for stateless API nodes.

rpc_transport_url.description: Message bus transport URL for RPC communication (e.g., RabbitMQ or other backends).

api_extensions.description: List of enabled Cinder API extensions. Keep default unless specific features are disabled.

rate_limits_enabled.description: Enable request rate limiting for the API.

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of requests allowed in a burst before throttling.

rate_limit_interval.description: Time window (in seconds) for rate limiting.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable HTTPS/TLS encryption for API traffic.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

ssl_ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate for client verification (optional).

cors_enabled.description: Enable CORS headers in API responses (for browser-based clients).

image_cache_enabled.description: Enable Cinder’s image cache manager for image-to-volume creation.

image_cache_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between image cache cleanup runs.

image_cache_size_gb.description: Maximum size (in GB) of the image cache directory.

storage_backends.description: List of storage backends to configure. Each backend defines a driver and its options.

name.description: Unique name for the backend (used in [backend_name] section header).

driver.description: Full Python import path to the backend driver class.

options.description: Driver-specific configuration options as key-value pairs.

scheduler_driver.description: Scheduler class for volume provisioning decisions.

scheduler_filters.description: List of scheduler filters to apply when placing new volumes.

service_token_roles.description: Required roles for service-to-service API calls.

service_token_required.description: Enforce service tokens for internal API calls for security.

message_ttl.description: Time-to-live (in seconds) for Cinder messages in the message queue.

backup_ceph_conf.description: Path to Ceph configuration file (only if backup_driver=ceph).

backup_ceph_user.description: Ceph user for backup operations (only if backup_driver=ceph).

backup_ceph_chunk_size_kb.description: Chunk size (KB) for incremental backups (only if backup_driver=ceph).

backup_ceph_pool.description: Ceph pool name for backup objects (only if backup_driver=ceph).

volume_transfer_enabled.description: Enable volume transfer functionality (e.g., for cross-tenant moves).

encryption_enabled.description: Enable encryption support in Cinder (requires backend support).

host_fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name used in self-referential API links (e.g., for reverse proxy setups).
